                               HEARING NOTICE
                    LICENSING BOARD FOR THE CITY BOSTON
               EMERGENCY LICENSED PREMISE INSPECTION HEARING

The Licensing Board for the City of Boston (the “Board”) is holding a virtual emergency
licensed premise inspection hearing on Tuesday, April 20, 2021 at 11:00a.m. to address
COVID-19 violations. Licensees observed in violation of any COVID-19 operational
requirement will be required to attend this emergency hearing and will face immediate
disciplinary action which may include, but is not limited to, the suspension or revocation of
any License issued by the Board. The Board reserves the right to amend this hearing notice
prior to the emergency hearing as necessary to reflect any Licensees observed in violation
of COVID-19 operational requirements.
